items.guidance: Since @prisma/client is present, look for a prisma/schema.prisma (possibly under api/) and a prisma/migrations directory; if migrations exist, the non-interactive production command is typically prisma migrate deploy, which requires the prisma CLI to be available in the image built from api/Dockerfile. If only a schema exists without migrations, report that rather than using db push against a shared database.

Check api/utils/sqsClient.js and its callers in the api code to identify which routes or services send messages to SQS_QUEUE_URL, and confirm whether the declared worker node workers/sqs-consumer.js is the consumer. Report whether production uses this queue, the producing and consuming files, and whether the consumer runs continuously or on a schedule.
